north_tiein: The two vertices and full north-facing wall on segment 0 retain revision 05 model coordinates. North stair/MU alignment and R1 entries are deferred. All other R5 vertices use this sheet registration. Upper east/west wall X lines continue the fixed north endpoints; their source residuals are reported.
limits: R5 XY follows a manual orthogonal enclosure trace and per-sheet dimensioned-grid calibration. This establishes source-governed provisional placement, not verified as-built dimensions.
The north wall and stair/MU alignment retain revision 05 geometry and the 42.443-pixel diagnostic maximum. R1 north entries are also deferred.
South MO/MJ outer jambs and contiguous interface replace the former MO/MU transcription and unsupported masonry gap. Complete internal frame profiles remain assumed without the schedule.

R5 sill/head dimensions, wall and slab thicknesses, parapet/coping sections and guards remain assumed or provisional. A2.08 is an independent diagnostic comparison, not a second authority for floor-plan wall positions.
Differences between plan and elevation projections are reported as residuals. No common dimensional accuracy tolerance or source agreement certificate is asserted.
disposition: R5 enclosure topology and south/east/west jambs provisionally reconciled; north work deferred and source discrepancies retained.
